title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Installment Count by Size of the Earlier-Year Balance
content:
The size scale of a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program installment arrangement sets the number of installments from the earlier-year enrollment's open balance on the day of the payment:

| Open balance | Installments set by the size scale |
|---|---|
| at least 200.00 | 3 |
| at least 25.00 and less than 200.00 | 2 |
| less than 25.00 | 1 |

| Boundary | Installments |
|---|---|
| 24.99 | 1 |
| 25.00 | 2 |
| 199.99 | 2 |
| 200.00 | 3 |

The open balance is every charge posted on the enrollment less every payment, Workforce Solutions remittance and credit posted on it.
